decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 17th November 2004 the proposed roof extension at 57 Hounslow Road, Feltham Hounslow would be lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The development falls within Class B Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the cubic content of the proposed roof extension and all applicable extensions would be 67.06m3, which would not exceed the maximum permitted volume of 70m3 for development to a semi-detached dwelling.

A planning application for the proposed development would not therefore be required.

This decision has been reached on the basis that the former first floor kitchen has been removed and that the use of the premises is as a single dwelling. Planning permission will be required for the roof extension in any other circumstances.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse
